tech.en: Python · SQLite · Alembic · Telegram Mini App

desc.en: Exam prep inside Telegram. It sends test PDFs, checks answers in a Mini App, scores SAT and National Certificate practice tests with the Rasch (1PL IRT) model, and generates PDF certificates. Five test categories and an admin panel, all in Telegram.
desc.uz: Telegram ichida imtihonga tayyorgarlik. Test PDF fayllarini yuboradi, javoblarni Mini App'da tekshiradi, SAT va Milliy sertifikat mashq testlarini Rasch (1PL IRT) modeli bilan baholaydi va PDF sertifikat yaratadi. 5 ta test toifasi va admin panel — hammasi Telegramda.
desc.ru: Подготовка к экзаменам прямо в Telegram. Бот отправляет PDF с тестами, проверяет ответы в Mini App, оценивает пробные тесты SAT и Национального сертификата по модели Rasch (1PL IRT) и создаёт PDF-сертификаты. 5 категорий тестов и админ-панель — всё в Telegram.

desc.en: A learning platform with student, teacher and CEO roles. Students buy courses with an in-app coin, teachers earn from them, and an AI teacher answers questions. Referrals, XP, tournaments and reviews.
desc.uz: O'quvchi, o'qituvchi va CEO rollariga ega ta'lim platformasi. O'quvchilar kurslarni ichki tanga bilan sotib oladi, o'qituvchilar daromad qiladi, sun'iy intellekt o'qituvchisi savollarga javob beradi. Referallar, XP, turnirlar va sharhlar.
desc.ru: Учебная платформа с ролями ученика, учителя и CEO. Ученики покупают курсы за внутреннюю монету, учителя на них зарабатывают, а ИИ-преподаватель отвечает на вопросы. Рефералы, XP, турниры и отзывы.

tech.en: HTML · CSS · JavaScript · built with an AI coding assistant

desc.en: I designed it and directed every change; an AI coding assistant wrote the code. Terminal UI, 2.5D ASCII portrait, matrix photo reveal, 3 languages and live chess.com ratings.

desc.ru: Я придумал дизайн и руководил каждым изменением; код написал ИИ-ассистент. Терминальный интерфейс, 2.5D ASCII-портрет, фото в стиле «Матрицы», 3 языка и живые рейтинги chess.com.

en.tag: 17 · Asaka, Uzbekistan · self-taught developer · coding teacher
beats: learned
I taught myself Python, Django and Linux from free YouTube videos.
taught
I asked 20 education centers to let me teach. 19 said I was too young. The 20th gave me a test and a demo lesson, and hired me. I've taught there for two summers.
proved
At the regional computer science olympiad, I took 1st. Two classmates I had tutored took 2nd and 3rd.
built
msr, a Telegram app that scores SAT practice tests with Rasch IRT. Now building N.O.K, a learning platform with an AI teacher. I build fast with AI: I vibe-code, then review and fix what it writes.
next
Computer Science and cybersecurity, and free online classes, like the videos that taught me.
